topic.source_contract: Building Safety Regulator higher-risk-building control evidence

facts.hrb_threshold: at least 7 storeys or 18 metres, and at least 2 residential units or hospital/care home
facts.scope_guard: BSR building-control approval is distinct from planning permission and does not prove construction completion.

facts.coverage: applications, determination times, outcomes and statutory-time performance from April to June 2026
facts.scope_guard: Aggregate application data is not a candidate application decision or delivery probability.

facts.separation: building regulations approval is different from planning permission
facts.scope_guard: The future levy date is not applied before it takes effect and does not establish candidate liability.
Strategic targets and process improvements are not individual project approvals or safety findings.

scope_guards: Height/storey and use thresholds must be applied together and are not inferred from a planning description alone.
BSR building-control approval and planning permission remain distinct statutory decisions.
A residential higher-risk building registration is not evidence of planning permission or construction completion.
Aggregate Gateway 2 transparency data is not a candidate approval probability.
Approval before work does not prove work started, reached commencement or completed.
The three-year commencement rule requires project-specific evidence and is not inferred from the approval date alone.
The 1 October 2026 Building Safety Levy date is not applied early or treated as exact liability.
No score or promotion is written without exact building dimensions/use, BSR application, decision, registration and planning evidence.
